modes.name: AI Sessions
modes.summary: See what's running: Claude Code, Codex and LM Studio, at a glance.
modes.description: Polls LM Studio's local server directly, and Claude Code / Codex process activity through a small Shortcut you set up once (there's no local API for those two — see the mode's README for the exact five-minute setup).
modes.author: vaho

modes.name: GitHub Glance
modes.summary: Open PRs and their CI status for a repo, one click from the notch.
modes.description: Lists open pull requests for a GitHub repo with combined check status, click to open in the browser. Works unauthenticated for public repos (rate-limited) or with a personal access token for private repos and a higher limit.
modes.author: vaho

modes.name: System Vitals
modes.summary: CPU, memory, network and battery with graphs, peaks and running totals — for people who want more than a glance.
modes.description: A deeper system panel than the built-in monitor: rolling graphs with min/avg/peak per metric, session-cumulative network transfer, battery health/charge, adjustable poll rate and a pause toggle.
modes.author: vaho

modes.name: Obsidian Capture
modes.summary: Drop a quick note into your Obsidian vault without leaving the notch.
modes.description: Appends text to today's daily note (or any file you name) in an Obsidian vault, through the Local REST API community plugin. Requires that plugin installed and enabled in Obsidian — see the mode's README for the two-minute setup.
modes.author: vaho

modes.name: Obsidian Search
modes.summary: Search your Obsidian vault and jump straight to a note.
modes.description: Full-text search over a vault through the Local REST API community plugin, with results opening directly in Obsidian via obsidian:// links.
modes.author: vaho
